fixes.explanation: Good guess, friend, because the law is a real and important word in the Bible. But it never shows up in this whole stretch of Jesus' teaching on the Mount of Olives. The word He picks in verse 10 is “gospel,” and it's the only one of the two that appears here. He says, “And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.” So when this verse asks what goes out to every nation, the answer is the gospel.
